SEARCH
Package persist.lint.api.spi

Interface PersistenceLinterFactory

All Known Subinterfaces:
NamedObjectParserFactory, SchemaValidatorFactory
All Known Implementing Classes:
JakartaNamedObjectParserFactory, JakartaPersistenceLinterFactory, JakartaSchemaValidatorFactory, LegacyNamedObjectParserFactory, LegacyPersistenceLinterFactory, LegacySchemaValidatorFactory
public interface PersistenceLinterFactory
Base factory interface for all persistence linter factories.

This interface defines the common contract shared by all linter factory types (NamedObjectParserFactory, SchemaValidatorFactory). Each implementation declares the persistence namespace it supports (e.g. "javax" or "jakarta") so that the correct strategy can be resolved for the target JPA specification version.

Concrete factory implementations are discovered at runtime through the ServiceLoader mechanism via the generic newPersistenceLinterFactory(String, Class) method.

Since:
2.1.0

    • newPersistenceLinterFactory

      static <T extends PersistenceLinterFactory> T newPersistenceLinterFactory(String jpaVersion, Class<T> factoryClass)
      Generic factory-discovery method that resolves a PersistenceLinterFactory subtype for the given JPA version.

      The version string is mapped to a persistence namespace ("javax" for versions 2.0–2.2, "jakarta" for versions 3.0–3.2) and the matching factory is located via the ServiceLoader API.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the factory subtype to resolve
      Parameters:
      jpaVersion - the JPA specification version (e.g. "2.2" or "3.1")
      factoryClass - the Class object of the desired factory type
      Returns:
      the factory implementation for the requested version
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the version is not recognized
      IllegalStateException - if no provider is registered for the resolved namespace
      Since:
      2.1.0
